section: chorus2_alone — 103.73-125.65 s (beats 224-271.5, bars 56-67.9). Files: src\scenes\08_chorus2.js (8 shots, 103.73-118.50, palette warm draining to off) and src\scenes\09_alone.js (2 shots, 118.50-125.65, palette off)
summary: Ten shots. 103.73-110.88 is still hot and orange: two macro keyword set-pieces built only from interface parts (the user's giant trembling typing dots for VIBRATIONS, the thinking spark closing into a full-frame ring for COMPLETION), no character art. 110.88-118.50 is four hard-cut pull-backs: each repeat of the 'left' line is one more unanswered message hanging from a longer dotted rail (+1 min ... +9 days), the presence chip goes online > away > offline, the palette drains warm > off, and the anime rain.png stands beside the thread as a picture pane that shrinks 572x858 > 240x360 > 112x168 and fades out under ISOLATION. alone-erase (118.50-121.73) deletes the seven unanswered rows on half-beats; every row flies off as a slab piece and FRAGMENTS lands across the seven pieces, beside a big grey halftone of parted.png. alone-empty (121.73-125.65) clears the rest, types the last sentence for about 2 s on an almost static grey page, then DISHEARTENED is on screen for 0.76 s (solid for about 0.3 s) before the same Delete popover erases it and the film hard-cuts to the equally grey, empty client of err-request. STORYBOARD.md is stale for this range (it still lists todo-alone and its line numbers are 1-based); the code and frames are the truth. Frame sheets I rendered: <scratchpad>/chorus2_alone_beat_1..3.png (one per beat), chorus2_alone_kwA..kwF.png (keyword hits and cuts), chorus2_alone_full_1..4.png (1920x1080).

diagnosis:
1. 'Cold grey grade is very good, replace the illustration, re-compose' (from about 113 s). The grade is not a filter: it is the palette blend drain(t) / pal (08_chorus2.js l.56-57), which moves only when the presence chip changes (0 until 112.96, 0.14 > 0.5 across left-away, 0.6 > 0.9 across left-offline, 0.93 > 1 across left-isolation), followed by the pure 'off' palette in both alone shots (sat 0; text #e4e2da, sub #aaa89f, mute #6f6e67 on bg #222220). art.draw desaturates with the palette by itself. That mechanism is what the director likes, and it is sound. What the frames show against it: at 112.96 the frame becomes two rectangles side by side, and the right one is the untreated anime painting rain.png at 572x858 (30% x 80% of the frame). It is the only painterly object in a flat interface, the largest and most detailed thing on screen, and it carries blue (night window) and gold (lamp), hues that exist nowhere else in a film whose rule is orange / cream / red / grey. In left-away it is still almost full colour (drain only 0.14-0.5), so the eye goes to the painting instead of to the thread, where the story is (the gap labels, the chip turning 'away', the composer letting go). One cut later it is 240x360 and then 112x168: at those sizes the painting is an unreadable noisy thumbnail. So the same asset is off-style where it is large and illegible where it is small. Nothing connects the pane to the window either: it is a framed picture hung next to the UI.
2. '[lyric] FRAGMENTS looks great, keep it; the blurred background image is good.' Confirmed in the frames: this is the one place in the section where the interface produces a physical graphic. Rows are selected and deleted on a strict half-beat grid (seven deletions, 118.96-120.34), the count rolls 10 > 3, the popover presses itself with no cursor, and what comes off the rows becomes seven slab pieces that the keyword then lands on, already broken. Rhythm, idea and legibility all work. What the director calls the blurred background image is technically not a blur: it is art.halftone (staggered dot screen, cell 9 px in alone-erase, 8 px in alone-empty, 'mute' grey at alpha 0.62 / 0.7) over a flat 'panel' art.silhouette of the same matte, plus a 50% 'bg' veil in alone-empty. Because the halftone samples a 160x240 luminance map of a detailed painting, the result is soft: at full size the figure reads as a tall dotted cone with a dark hollow where the face is, not as her. As atmosphere that is fine (it is why the director reads it as 'blurred'), but it is the treatment that is good, not the source picture.
3. 'DISHEARTENED is a strong emotion, the picture lacks impact.' Measured: hit at 124.89, cut at 125.65, 0.76 s = 1.65 beats in total; the last letter lands at 125.17 and the delete sweep starts at 125.21, so the complete solid word exists for a few frames only and is a struck-through outline by 125.49. It sits in the lower-left quadrant inside a message box with two other rows, at 54% of the frame width and 8% of its height, light grey on dark grey. The 'off' palette has no saturated colour, so the global bloom does nothing; flash 0.1 in grey and a 6 px shake are invisible. There is no cut, no camera move (zoom 1.04 > 1.00 over 4 s), no change in the figure, no change of composition: the frame at 125.12 differs from the frame at 124.70 only by one more line of type and a box. It is also preceded by about 2 s (122.9-124.89, 4.3 beats) in which only typing moves, while the music does not drop at all (mean RMS 0.57 here versus 0.56 in the hot first half of this chorus), and it is followed by a hard cut into err-request, which is another grey, quiet, wide interface shot with an empty thread. So the strongest word of the phrase is the smallest event of its neighbourhood: grey-still > 0.3 s of a grey word being deleted > grey-still. Compare with VIBRATIONS and COMPLETION one phrase earlier (own shot, about 1475 px or full-frame ring, glow, flash). The story idea is right and worth keeping (the AI deletes even its last message, the thread reads 0 messages), but it erases the word before the viewer can feel it, and nothing in the picture carries the emotion itself.
4. Relation to the overall note about monotony: 110.88-118.50 is four consecutive hard cuts of the same family (a chat column in a room, each time further away) and 121.73-125.65 is a fifth interface page; the only non-interface elements in 22 s after COMPLETION are the anime pane, the halftone figure and the slab pieces. The first 7 s (c2-dots, c2-complete) already do what the director asks for elsewhere.
5. New art, measured (圖片/Claude娘剪影, four transparent RGBA PNGs): 1 = '...01_30_47-1.png' 1254x1254, three-quarter close-up, one eye visible, stern sideways look; 2 = '...01_31_01-2.png' 1086x1448, eyes closed, one hand on the chest, the other reaching out towards the viewer (the plea pose); 3 = '...01_31_04-3.png' 1086x1448, profile facing LEFT, head lowered, eye hidden by hair; 4 = '...01_31_06-4.png' 1086x1449, frontal bust with the face entirely black (faceless). Inks are flat: orange about #dc6d3d (luminance 0.51), cream about #f2e2c8 (0.89), black about #241916 (0.11), i.e. the film's own 'me' / 'text' / 'bg' roles. Under art.draw with sat 0 they become three clean greys; under art.halftone the dot radius is cell*0.62*sqrt(L), so cream, hair and black become three distinct dot sizes (about 0.58 / 0.44 / 0.21 of the cell) and a bust will stay readable where the painting turned to mush. Each file also carries 5,400-8,000 stray pure-red pixels (R>200, G and B<60, alpha>0) scattered around the outline, visible as red specks on a dark ground; they need a matte clean-up, all the more because red is reserved for errors and saturated pixels trigger the bloom. All four are busts (3:4 or 1:1), none is a full figure and none shows a desk or laptop, so 'she is at the laptop, waiting' (moment text of left-away) no longer describes any available picture.
keep: The grade: drain(t) and pal in 08_chorus2.js l.56-57 (palette blend warm > off, stepping only when the presence chip changes) and palette 'off' for both shots of 09_alone.js. This is the 'cold grey filter' the director praises; any new art should go through art.draw / halftone / silhouette so it drains with it.

The chat content and its staging in 110.88-118.50: column() l.141-198 (user's sign-off bubble + timestamp, answer row, each unanswered message on a dotted rail whose length is the wait: GAPS l.23, labels and timestamps from script.left_anchor / left_sequence in docs/v3/chat_script.json l.902-903), chip() with its ring burst on change (l.99-110), the sidebar folding (fold, l.59), the composer letting go (l.405), the window frame letting go (bare, l.419-422), the pointer leaving (l.406).

speck() (l.201-221) and the ISOLATION letter-spacing in left-isolation (l.444-449): the far view of the thread is the bridge the next shot scales up from (alone-erase l.206-207 starts the thread at 960,350 scale 0.42).

The whole FRAGMENTS mechanism in 09_alone.js: the half-beat grid tDel / tSel (l.34), history() (l.133-165: highlight, strike-through, row closing 58 > 36 px, 'deleted by me' stub, column hanging from the line being written via layA l.91-96), menu() (l.71-81) climbing with easeBack and pressing on every deletion (l.214-220), count() rolling 10 > 3 (l.50-59, l.201-202), the slab geometry KB / cutX / JIT / PIECES (l.18, l.99-114), pieceAt() (l.119-130: 0.42 s flight, 84 px hop, rotation, bar-to-outline morph, 4-sample trail), apart() (l.116: snap together at the hit, drift apart after), and the keyword drawn once per piece through ctx.clipPath (l.222-232).
The rule that there is no pointer for the AI: every deletion is shown by the interface itself (row highlight, popover pressing its one item, count). Keep it in any redesign of the last deletion.

The two-layer figure treatment as a treatment: flat 'panel' art.silhouette under a staggered art.halftone in 'mute' (cell 8-9 px, alpha 0.6-0.7), plus the 50% 'bg' veil in alone-empty that puts her behind the glass. Change the source image, keep the recipe (re-tune cell and alpha for flat art).

The first 7 s untouched: c2-typing, c2-dots, c2-brb, c2-complete (dotsBubble l.77-86, the tremble wave l.272-282, the petal-by-petal ring l.309-319, the closed ring l.334-360). Not criticised, and already 'graphics that hit on the beat outside the normal chat framing'.
The end state at 125.65: empty thread, '0 messages', chip 'offline', composer placeholder, palette 'off', no red. err-request opens on exactly this state (10_error.js l.157 header sub '0 messages').

The story logic of the last keyword (script beat 'empty-thread' in docs/v3/chat_script.json: the AI deletes its own last message and only then the count reads 0). It can remain as the tail of a bigger hit; what has to change is how much picture the word gets before it is taken back.
problems: left-away 112.96-114.81: untreated full-colour anime rain.png at 572x858 (30% x 80% of the frame) beside the window. Only painterly and only multi-hue object (blue window, gold lamp) in the film's two-ink interface; it out-shouts the thread, where the story happens; composition is two unrelated rectangles.

left-offline and left-isolation: the same painting at 240x360 and then 112x168 is an unreadable thumbnail; in left-isolation it has faded to nothing by 118.24, so the right half of the frame is simply empty for the last 0.26 s.

alone-erase / alone-empty: the halftone of parted.png has no readable face or silhouette logic (a dotted cone with a dark hollow); FIG_A (850x1275) is a full 2:3 figure that runs past the bottom of the frame and FIG_B uses a crop written in parted.png pixel coordinates (CROP_B 180,0,664,900). The new art is busts in 3:4 and 1:1, so both placements have to be re-composed, not just re-pointed. In alone-erase the slab (930,784,850x176) currently sits over the figure's skirt; a bust has nothing there.

DISHEARTENED 124.89-125.65: 1.65 beats in total, solid and complete for a few frames, struck through by 125.49; 54% x 8% of the frame, lower left, grey on grey, no glow, no cut, no camera move, no reaction from the figure; flash 0.1 and 6 px shake are invisible in the 'off' palette (the bloom only reacts to saturated colour).
About 2 s of near-stasis before it (122.9-124.89): one grey sentence being typed over a veiled grey figure, camera easing out 4%, while the audio level stays at chorus level.
Grey-to-grey hard cut at 125.65 into err-request: no punctuation between the 'alone' section and the error section; the struck-through outline just vanishes.

Four consecutive hard cuts of the same framing family (110.88, 112.96, 114.81, 117.34: a chat column in a room, further away each time). Together with alone-empty that is the stretch where the director's general 'always inside the chat UI' complaint applies inside this section.

The new art is not wired in at all: the loader only knows ART_NAMES = library, tea, rain, gaze, plea, parted in assets/character; the new files live in 圖片/ under names with spaces and CJK characters, in other sizes (1086x1448, 1254x1254 instead of 1024x1536), with no entries in assets/character/regions.json (picture() asks for 'crops.bust'), and each carries 5,400-8,000 stray pure-red fringe pixels.

room() draws a blurred rain.png as the wall in all ten shots of this section (and 10_error.js l.94 after it). It is not recognisable as an illustration, but in the warm shots its blurred hair and window are what tints the margins; if rain.png is to leave the film entirely, the room needs a new blur source or a code-only wall.
